Select compound_structures.canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, activities.standard_type, activities.standard_relation, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units. From assays. Join activities on assays via assays.assay_id = activities.assay_id. Join molecule_dictionary on activities via activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno. Join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary via molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613797'. Filter activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL. Filter activities.standard_relation = '='. Sort by compound_structures.canonical_smiles ASC, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id ASC, activities.standard_type ASC, activities.standard_relation ASC, activities.standard_value ASC, activities.standard_units ASC.
